pattern: A labelled group with a Draw/Type pair of toggle buttons (aria-pressed), the canvas as role=img whose name describes its content, a native text field for the typed-name alternative, and undo and clear buttons. Drawing is pointer-only, so the typed mode provides the keyboard and screen-reader path (WCAG 2.1.1, 2.5.7).

aria.value: 'Signature pad, empty', '... drawn with 3 strokes', or '... typed signature: Ana Ruiz'
true when invalid in type mode

keyboard.action: Moves through Draw, Type, the typed field, Undo, and Clear.
Switch to drawing or typing; Type focuses the name field.
Remove the last stroke or the whole signature.
The name is drawn on the pad as the signature.

focus: Focus never moves into the canvas; Type moves focus to the name field.
notes: The typed alternative is always offered, not hidden behind a setting.
Undo and clear are announced through the polite live region.
knownCaveats: Manual screen-reader verification (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver) is pending.
